title: Slovakian-Italian Turkey Dumplings
description: A unique twist on traditional Italian dumplings, infused with the hearty flavors of Slovakia.
instructions: Cook dumplings according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook turkey over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add diced ham to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Stir in mustard and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add cooked dumplings to the skillet and toss with the turkey and ham mixture.
Season with parsley and serve hot.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as marinara sauce or sautéed vegetables.
